1.web: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.
1.asv: Save me, O God, by thy name, And judge me in thy might.

2.web: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
2.asv: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.

3.web: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.
3.asv: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul: They have not set God before them. [Selah

4.web: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.
4.asv: Behold, God is my helper: The Lord is of them that uphold my soul.

5.web: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
5.asv: He will requite the evil unto mine enemies: Destroy thou them in thy truth.

6.web: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Yahweh, for it is good.
6.asv: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto thee: I will give thanks unto thy name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

7.web: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.
7.asv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath seen my desire upon mine enemies.
